summary: Skeletal human remains discovered by law enforcement during an active search mission for missing woman Edna Quintana; found in the foothills west of Saguache Peak off County Road 46AA; believed to be a male about 5 ft 9 in (pants 36 waist by 30 length), not Quintana's; CBI released the details on behalf of the Saguache County Sheriff's Office with a public-identification appeal; identity and cause of death unknown at publication
location: Foothills west of Saguache Peak, off County Road 46AA
responding_agency: Saguache County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Bureau of Investigation
notes: Found during the search for Edna Quintana (missing since early May 2023 while rock hunting; her remains were found June 2025, indexed as id 3207); remains not believed to be hers. Precedent: ids 2606/3296/2912 carry remains-recovery rows with SAR involvement.
